in_sanskrit.name: Mangilal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Power, Auspicious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mangilal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mangilal is a Sanskrit name derived from the two words 'Man' and 'Gili'. 'Man' means 'mind' and 'Manas' in Sanskrit, symbolizing wisdom and consciousness. 'Gili' means 'lord' or 'god', reflecting power and divinity. In Hindu mythology, Mangilal is associated with the god Vishnu, who is revered as the preserver of the universe and is considered an embodiment of power and wisdom. The name is considered auspicious and is believed to bring good luck and prosperity.
